turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The debt management plan is agreed, I will pay four hundred pounds a month for five years.
Take your time.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. It is not easy to talk about.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Arjun drew a picture of our family with all three of us holding hands, and I had to leave the room.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I keep coming back to it.
And how was that for you?
I called Frank from the group when the urge came and we talked until the match ended.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. That is how it was.
How did that feel for you?
I realised I am turning into my father and that terrifies me.
What happened next?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. It is not easy to talk about.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
